lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\Overleaf\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

boot() registers a listener or takes a service from the container in 1 place. boot() runs once for every process of the server, so each of them is built on every request. registerEventListener() in register() builds a listener only when its event fires.

places: lib/Service/OverleafService.php:46 OCP\Constants::PERMISSION_READ: deprecated since Nextcloud 13; Use \OCP\Constants::PERMISSION_READ instead
lines: 1 use in 1 file of the public API that is deprecated in Nextcloud 33 to 35. The text of the tag names the replacement where it has one.
lib/Service/OverleafService.php:46 OCP\Constants::PERMISSION_READ: deprecated since Nextcloud 13; Use \OCP\Constants::PERMISSION_READ instead

The app reads and writes its app config in 2 places and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.
